source.name: Saltwater News reviewed launch sources
source.provenance: Human-reviewed public operator and regional report pages; each record retains its original canonical URL

reports.title: September 16-17 Highlands bluefin report
reports.summary: The operator reported a slower start followed by a strong jig-and-live-bait window, with nine hookups from fourteen opportunities and legal fish retained under the trip limit.
reports.evidence_excerpt: Direct operator report reviewed September 18, 2026; catch figures and retention language preserved without inference.

reports.title: Point Pleasant fluke, sea bass and bluefish report
reports.summary: The boat reported an improved keeper ratio for fluke to the north, sea bass in the mix, and continued limits-plus bluefish action before an approaching windy period.

reports.title: Northern New Jersey fluke, bluefish and bluefin roundup
reports.summary: Reports pointed to wind-sensitive fluke fishing, chummed bluefish limits, and school bluefin activity in northern New Jersey waters.
reports.evidence_excerpt: Regional fishing reporter roundup dated September 17, 2026.

reports.title: Southern New Jersey regional report
reports.summary: The regional roundup described fluke concentrating on ocean reefs and wrecks, pelagics along beaches and inlets, and mahi around offshore structure.

reports.title: Outer Banks September regional report
reports.summary: The September regional report described billfish and mahi offshore, Spanish mackerel nearshore, and red drum activity inshore and along the beachfront.
reports.evidence_excerpt: Regional report with named marina, tackle-shop, and fleet contributors.

reports.title: St. Augustine offshore report
reports.summary: The operator reported mixed offshore and bottom action in roughly 80 to 120 feet, using ballyhoo and sardines.
